_comment: Mock-mode chat scripts (app/llm/mock_chat.py). Numbers in 'say' come only from tool results: {tool.field}.

steps.say: You've opened {get_usage.merchant} {get_usage.opens_text} so far. If you keep it, the first paid year costs {get_savings_estimate.per_year_text}. {review_subscription.act_by_text}. It's your call: say "cancel Penwright" and I'll show a confirmation card, or tap Keep.

If you do nothing, I ask you on {review_subscription.check_in_on}. If you still don't answer, your safety timer cancels {review_subscription.merchant} in PayPal on {review_subscription.auto_cancel_on}, before the first charge on {review_subscription.first_charge_on}. {review_subscription.act_by_text}: the terms also want written notice, so I'll remind you to send the cancellation email.

I draft the cancellation email right after {review_subscription.merchant} is cancelled in PayPal. It quotes the notice clause word for word, and you check, edit and send it yourself. {review_subscription.act_by_text}. To start, say "cancel Penwright" and tap Confirm on the card.

args.reason: You asked me to cancel it.

steps.say: Cancelling {propose_cancel.merchants} keeps {propose_cancel.total_per_year_text} in your pocket. Nothing happens until you tap Confirm.
